item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A humid easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China gradually later tomorrow. There will be a few fog patches over the region in the next couple of days. A cold front is expected to move across the coastal areas on Saturday night to Sunday and bring a few showers over the region. There will be thunderstorms over inland areas. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, it will become cool over the coastal areas on Sunday. The weather will improve gradually early to midweek next week. It will be dry, the weather will be cool in the morning and at night.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Warm with sunny intervals during the day. Fog patches and one or two rain patches in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 22 - 26 C
